name: Vladimir Lenin

names.name: Vladimir Ilyich Ulyanov
names.period: the name he was born with

roles.title: Leader of the Bolshevik faction, Russian Social Democratic Labour Party
Chairman of the Council of People's Commissars

summary: A lawyer's son from Simbirsk who spent most of his adult life in exile arguing about organisation, and who arrived at the argument that a disciplined party of professional revolutionaries was the necessary instrument of a revolution rather than its expression. He was in Zurich when the Tsar fell and reached Petrograd only in April 1917, having crossed Germany in a sealed carriage the German government was glad to provide. From that April his position - no support for the Provisional Government, no continuation of the war, all power to the Soviets - was for six months a minority view even inside his own party, and by October it was the majority view in the capital. He headed the government that resulted until his health broke in 1922.
